purpose: Make the mile-high purpose, moral ambition, and earned-capability posture legible to future sessions without converting dreams into premature implementation commitments.
governing_maxim: Dream big, gate hard, claim carefully.

statements.name: public_record_substrate_not_accusation_product
statements.statement: The cube exists to make public accountability records preservable, normalizable, contestable, and useful before it exists to accuse any person.
statements.why_it_matters: A source-bound substrate can support journalism, defense work, research, oversight, families, and community memory without collapsing uncertainty into accusation.
statements.seed_linkage: The seed calls for a normalized, jurisdiction-spanning, longitudinal record built from public records, court filings, news, FOIA releases, and civil-society datasets.
not_a_commitment_to: public officer lookup as first product

statements.name: make_wandering_structurally_difficult
statements.statement: The mature cube should make it difficult for officers with serious, source-supported histories to disappear through jurisdictional fragmentation and reappear unobserved elsewhere.
statements.why_it_matters: The seed identifies wandering officers as the most important consequence of fragmented public records.

statements.name: earn_every_public_claim
statements.statement: The archive may remember more than it displays, but every public claim must be earned by source custody, bounded wording, claim state, freshness, privacy review, and rollback path.
statements.why_it_matters: The project is legally and morally fragile if it turns partial records into unqualified banners.
must_earn: preserved source or transparently unresolved source
not_a_commitment_to: maximal openness for every public record

statements.name: hold_people_and_institutions_together
statements.statement: The cube must be able to represent individual conduct, institutional patterns, policies, contracts, budgets, settlements, supervision, and reform timelines without letting any one layer erase the others.
statements.why_it_matters: A pure officer database feeds the bad-apple frame; a pure institution database can hide repeat individuals.

statements.name: civilian_dignity_is_not_optional
statements.statement: The cube must protect civilians, witnesses, families, minors, survivors, vulnerable communities, and people in crisis even when source records are public.
statements.why_it_matters: Accountability records often contain the names and trauma of people who never consented to becoming data infrastructure.
not_a_commitment_to: displaying every name because a source did

statements.name: due_process_is_an_accountability_requirement
statements.statement: Allegation, investigation, finding, settlement, reversal, exoneration, acquittal, decertification, reinstatement, and correction must remain distinct.
statements.why_it_matters: The cube should be trustworthy enough to help accountability precisely because it refuses careless collapse.

statements.name: missingness_is_a_public_fact
statements.statement: The cube should expose the structure of missing, sealed, destroyed, denied, stale, paywalled, inaccessible, or ambiguous records without pretending that missing means absent.
statements.why_it_matters: Fragmentation itself is one of the accountability facts the project must make legible.

statements.name: serve_many_civic_users_without_becoming_the_police_tool
statements.statement: The cube should support journalists, public defenders, civil-rights litigators, researchers, oversight bodies, families, community organizers, legislators, and monitors while resisting use as police intelligence against civilians.
statements.why_it_matters: The seed names broad civic audiences, but access and presentation choices decide whether the infrastructure helps accountability or surveillance.

statements.name: local_specificity_plus_national_normalization
statements.statement: The cube must preserve local legal vocabulary, agency structures, union contracts, disclosure regimes, and record quirks while normalizing enough to compare across jurisdictions.
statements.why_it_matters: A national corpus becomes false if it erases local meaning; a purely local archive cannot reveal mobility or cross-jurisdiction patterns.

statements.name: corrections_and_rollback_are_core_not_afterthoughts
statements.statement: The cube should treat corrections, defeaters, source withdrawal, appeals, stale status, mismerges, and public challenges as ordinary lifecycle events.
statements.why_it_matters: Long-lived accountability infrastructure must expect change and contestation rather than pretending archival entries are static.
not_a_commitment_to: immutable public claims without amendment path

statements.name: dream_big_then_gate_hard
statements.statement: Future sessions should be allowed to imagine broad products, new pilots, international extensions, and radical civic interfaces, then gate them carefully rather than refusing to dream.
statements.why_it_matters: The project can die by recklessness or by overconstraint; foundation work should protect ambition as well as protect people.
not_a_commitment_to: locking the project into DOJ SLS

statements.name: the_archive_should_make_democracy_less_forgetful
statements.statement: At scale, the cube should turn scattered, perishable, local accountability records into durable democratic memory that communities and institutions can use to act.
statements.why_it_matters: The seed frames the corpus as infrastructure: a shared spine for downstream accountability projects rather than a replacement for them.
